Around [[67 BBY/Legends|67 BBY]], the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Venamis]] possessed a '''starship'''. This ship was used to transport him to [[Sojourn (moon)|Sojourn]] where he [[Contest on Sojourn|dueled]] the [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]]. In the aftermath of his defeat, the ship was removed and stored.
